text:
The implementation incorrectly computes the number of full binary trees. A full binary tree must have an odd number of vertices; the given recurrence sums over all left subtree sizes, producing non-zero values for even n and Catalan numbers for odd n (e.g., B₃ = 5 instead of 1). The time complexity claim of O(n²) is also wrong—the naive recursion runs in exponential time without memoization. The answer shows some recursive structure but fails to correctly solve the problem.

Rating: [[2]]
